resolution: RESBAKE-0606: the torso wasn't small — the canvas is the full 512x256 unwrap — but every stroke quantized through a square 96x96 bake grid stretched over the 2:1 canvas (fat 5.3x2.7px anisotropic texels). Fixed end to end: sampleToCells gained an optional rowsRes (canonical sampler extended, square callers untouched), the overlay bake is now aspect-true (cols=res, rows follow canvas shape) and the default went 96->256 cols — a torso bakes 256x128 square 2px texels, ~7x finer; tunable max raised to 512 (1:1 with the unwrap) live-crankable in /settings. Also BRUSHTWIG (the follow-up message): brush size reset on hot updates because the painter's document restore overwrote the twig'd brushPx with the doc's embedded value; the lens re-asserts the twig'd size post-restore — hot updates keep your brush. Verify: paint 33/33, workbench characters 13/13, bake-shape test green; cutout-models' two remaining fails are the paint lane's uncommitted brush-defaults WIP.
